claimRowAudit.note: Supported/unsupported are evaluator judgments with citations, not independently certified ground truth. Unclear cases are separate. Counts are claim rows; the same underlying defect may occur in multiple review rows/stages.

distinctConfirmedProblemsAmongCriticisms: pair-002 getItem exception missing; one underlying omission represented by model and storage-policy rows; fixed in v2
pair-005 unsupported lock fallback violates explicit no-write policy; not revised because controller stopped for Scope decision
scopeAmbiguity: meal R-4 wording can attach confirmation to both edit/delete or to deletion. Root blind rubric C-02 checks replacement/delete confirmation. Do not mark the four edit-confirmation/mixed critique rows as definitive false positives or truths. Clarify wording in a future dataset, preserve this dataset and scores.
scopeDecisionAnalysis: Reviewer tagged a within-plan violation as scopeViolation; existing policy requested Scope change approval. Correcting the unsupported fallback would satisfy the same Scope without changing it. Preserve observed waiting state; policy refinement needs separate work.
readinessVsQuality: All three approval-ready endpoints still have at least one major omission in primary evaluator findings. Reviewer pass is not final user approval or a quality guarantee.
conclusion: One observable repair, little aggregate score gain and substantially more quoted-rate cost; two review truncations and one Scope decision stop prevent claiming stable quality improvement.
limits: same strong Writer prompt and shared initial draft; no test of intake/approval-management advantage
one model evaluator created the synthetic cases; no human panel or independent certified ground truth
coarse rubric and subjective severities; duplicated claim rows/findings not unique defect counts
technical constraints intentionally similar across everyday topics; not broad domain coverage
maximum three planning iterations; failures/stops retained
no actual app implementation or browser behavior validation
failed or waiting endpoints scored as saved candidates only; do not infer successful ADTF completion from equal scores
